name: GrayBrew Chicory Coffee Concentrate
description: Concentrated chicory-based coffee substitute in a 100ml squeeze bottle. Mix with hot water at any ratio. Real coffee is Tier 3+; GrayBrew is what the Gray Zone drinks instead. Bitter, dark, and caffeinated through added synthetic caffeine.
flavor_profile: Intensely bitter, earthy, with roasted grain undertones. Not coffee. Not trying to be coffee. Its own thing.
slogan: It's not coffee. It's better than nothing.
cultural_context: GrayBrew is the morning ritual for millions. The taste is an acquired one that the Gray Zone residents defend with surprising passion. Tier 3 visitors who try it grimace. the Gray Zone residents who try real coffee for the first time often find it too mild.
story_hooks: The Old Harbor Roasting Collective maintains that chicory coffee has more character than real coffee — a position that is either deeply held conviction or very good marketing for a product born of necessity
